scripts.text:
[Gyo]
How would you define victory?
To fell the enemy...
However, the most important thing is...
Never to fall yourself!
scripts.translation:
[京]
你如何定義勝利？
擊敗敵人...
然而，最重要的是...
自己絕不倒下！

scripts.text:
[Gyo]
For that, you must better protect yourself.
You cannot protect 'others' while you hinder your 'own' protection.
scripts.translation:
[京]
為此，你必須更好地保護自己。
在無法保護“自己”的情況下，是無法保護“他人”的。

scripts.text: Combine armor.
scripts.translation: 合成防具

scripts.text: End conversation.
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Gyo]
Prudence is also an important virtue in battle.
scripts.translation:
[京]
謹慎也是戰鬥中重要的美德。

scripts.text: Wolf Armguard[1]
scripts.translation: 狼紋護手[1]

scripts.text: Crescent Armguard[1]
scripts.translation: 月紋護手[1]

scripts.text: Ninja Scale Armor[1]
scripts.translation: 忍者鱗甲[1]

scripts.text: Tenebris Latitantes[1]
scripts.translation: 霧中暗影[1]

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Gyo]
Wolf Armguard... One beastly piece of armor.
scripts.translation:
[京]
狼紋護手... 一件充滿野性的防具。

scripts.text:
[Gyo]
Do you feel the nature of the wolf?
Both wild and charming...
scripts.translation:
[京]
你能感受到狼的本性嗎？
既狂野又迷人...

scripts.text:
[Gyo]
Crescent Armguard... A thing of beauty and strength... With none the lesser.
scripts.translation:
[京]
月紋護手... 兼具美麗與力量... 二者皆不遜色。

scripts.text:
[Gyo]
Such beauty...
As if the whole body is overflowing with magic.
scripts.translation:
[京]
如此之美...
彷彿全身都溢滿了魔力。

scripts.text:
[Gyo]
Ninja Scale Armor... It's said that a legendary Ninja once wore it.
scripts.translation:
[京]
忍者鱗甲... 據說曾有一位傳奇忍者穿戴過它。

scripts.text:
[Gyo]
This is truly a legendary armor...
Even if I don't believe in legends...
scripts.translation:
[京]
這確實是傳說中的防具...
即使我不相信傳說...

scripts.text:
[Gyo]
Shadow King's Armor... It was made to protect others.
scripts.translation:
[京]
暗影之王的鎧甲... 它是為了守護他人而打造的。

scripts.text:
[Gyo]
How is it?
Does the armor not appear as if there are two?
scripts.translation:
[京]
感覺如何？
這件防具看起來不像只有一件嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gyo]
You don't have enough ingredients.
Look again...
scripts.translation:
[京]
你的材料不足。
再看看吧...

scripts.text: Combine.
scripts.translation: 組合

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Gyo]
Looks like you need more time to decide.
scripts.translation:
[京]
看來你還需要更多時間來決定。

scripts.text: [Gyo]

[Gyo]
To make a ^ff0000Wolf Armguard, you need 1 Fox Armguard and 10 Blood of Wolf^000000.
Can you feel it? The throbbing of the wolf blood...
scripts.translation:
[京]
製作^ff0000狼紋護手，需要1個狐紋護手和10個狼血^000000。
你能感受到嗎？狼血的搏動...

scripts.text:
[Gyo]
To make a ^ff0000Crescent Armguard, you need 1 Fox Armguard and 100 Crystal Fragments^000000.
A crescent as beautiful and clear as a crystal will be engraved on it.
scripts.translation:
[京]
製作^ff0000月紋護手，需要1個狐紋護手和100個水晶碎片^000000。
上面將刻有如同水晶般美麗清澈的新月。

scripts.text:
[Gyo]
To make a ^ff0000Ninja Scale Armor, you need 30 Fire Dragon Scales, 30 Ice Scales, and 30 Darkred Scale Pieces^000000.
You can feel its legendary powers.
scripts.translation:
[京]
製作^ff0000忍者鱗甲，需要30個脫落的紅色龍鱗、30個冰塊鱗片和30個紅鱗碎片^000000。
你能感受到它傳說中的力量。

scripts.text:
[Gyo]
To make a ^ff0000Shadow King's Armor, you'll need a Special Ninja Suit with a slot and 10 Dark Pieces^000000.
With the darkness it erases existence itself...
scripts.translation:
[京]
製作^ff0000暗影之王護甲，需要1件帶插槽的特攻忍裝和10個黑暗碎片^000000。
那抹黑暗甚至能抹消存在本身...

scripts.text:
[Gyo]
Make sure that ^ff0000you have the correct ingredients and equipment at hand^000000.
No use crying over it later.
scripts.translation:
[京]
請確保^ff0000你手頭有正確的材料和裝備^000000。
不然到時候後悔也來不及了。

scripts.text:
[Gyo]
Looks like you need more time to decide.
scripts.translation:
[京]
看來你還需要更多時間來決定。

scripts.text:
[Ki]
To attack is the best means of defense.
A powerful weapon ill make you truly complete.
scripts.translation:
[基]
進攻是最好的防守。
一把強力的武器會讓你真正變得完美。

scripts.text:
[Ki]
Of course, it would be better to have something special at hand.
scripts.translation:
[基]
當然，手頭有一件特別的武器會更好。

scripts.text: Combine weapon.
scripts.translation: 組合武器

scripts.text: End conversation.
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Ki]
Being too careful could sometimes be lethal.
scripts.translation:
[基]
有時候，過於謹慎反而致命。

Raksasa Dagger can only be used after plenty of training.

scripts.text:
[Ki]
Ah...
What a beautiful luster...
scripts.translation:
[基]
啊...
多麼美麗的光澤...

scripts.text:

Hmm... You do not have enough to make a Raksasa Dagger.
Why don't you check again?
Some just can't give up what they hold.

有些人就是無法割捨手中的東西。

scripts.text:
[Ki]
Mikatsuki... A beautiful curve like the crescent moon...
There aren't many who can make them.
scripts.translation:
[基]
三日月...如同新月般美麗的弧度...
能製作它的人並不多。

scripts.text:
[Ki]
Truly beautiful...
I am so fortunate to be able to see such a magnificent dagger.
scripts.translation:
[基]
真是美麗...
能親眼見到如此華麗的短劍，
我真是太幸運了。

scripts.text:

Huuma Swirling Petal... Have you ever seen petals swirl?
scripts.translation:

風魔手裡劍亂華...你見過花瓣飛舞的樣子嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ki]
Flying... petals!!
scripts.translation:
[基]
飛舞的...花瓣！！

It may seem like too many shurikens are needed... But it is essential for the beautiful fluttering effect.

雖然看起來需要很多飛鏢...但這是實現美麗飛舞效果所必需的。
